**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation burdening Meridian Fieldworks. § 12.3 expressly records that Customer has made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment," and neither pricing provision functions as a disguised MFN — § 7.1 fixes Fees at Order Form levels and bars undisclosed charges, while § 8.3 caps renewal increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. Both run in our favour. Targeted searches for MFN, "no less favourable", price-matching and third-party-comparison language returned no results. This sits at the playbook's preferred position.
